about: Reviewed hits of the site's leak gate (scripts/leak-gate.mjs) that cannot be edited away here. Each row covers exactly `count` hits of that kind (and salted hash prefix) in that file: one more is a new leak and one fewer is a stale row, and both fail the deploy. A canary is never listed. The list only shrinks: a row goes when its pre-registration is amended.
